title: Delivery receipt
description: Proof that an in-kind donation arrived: every donated item checked against the nonprofit's delivery photo, with what the check could not establish. Donor names are not included.

issuedAt.description: When the nonprofit shared the checked proof.

donations.description: Each donor's part of the delivery, anonymized as donor-1, donor-2, ...

items.description: Every product in the delivery, summed across donors, as checked against the photo.

seen.description: Count visible in the photo, null if it can't be counted.

where.description: Where the item sits in the photo, in words.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored photo. Recompute it to prove the photo wasn't swapped.

dhash.description: 64-bit difference hash, used to catch the same photo reused for another delivery.

replaced.description: Earlier proofs of this delivery that the nonprofit replaced, oldest first.

genuine.description: No AI content label, not reused, no strong visual signs of AI.

aiContentLabel.description: C2PA / IPTC DigitalSourceType label found in the file.

cameraTimestamp.description: Informational. Missing is normal for photos sent over messaging apps.

takenInApp.description: Shot with the app's live camera, not picked from the gallery (reported by the app).

locationSharedWithPlatform.description: The phone's location was shared with the platform at capture. Never published.

packingSlipMatchesOrder.description: A readable packing slip shows this delivery's order code. null if no slip was readable.

passedCheck.description: false when the nonprofit sent the photo without it passing the check

verdict.description: partial: the photo is genuine but doesn't show every product. unverified: the nonprofit sent it without the photo passing the check.

limits.description: What this check could not establish.
